description: Discovery entry point for compounds. Find by name / ChEMBL ID / InChIKey with the default search_type=name (supply query), or run a structure search with search_type exact | similarity | substructure (supply structure as a SMILES). At least one of query or structure is required, and structure is required for the three structure modes. Returns ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, formula, MW, AlogP, Lipinski violations, QED, max clinical phase, and the family parent_chembl_id on every row; only search_type=similarity adds a Tanimoto similarity percent. Chain molecule_chembl_id into chembl_get_bioactivities or chembl_get_drug_info. A salt often ranks ahead of its parent and carries a small share of the family's measurements, so check parent_chembl_id before chaining. A capped result carries nextCursor — pass it back as cursor with the same filters to read the next page.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous call's nextCursor — resumes where that page ended. Omit for the first page. Re-send the same query/structure/filters that minted it (only limit may change; it sets this page's size); redeeming it against different filters walks a different result set.

limit.description: Maximum molecules to return, up to 100 — a larger value is served at 100, with a notice saying so. Defaults to the server default (25) when omitted.

max_phase_min.description: For search_type=name, restrict to compounds at or above this max clinical phase (e.g. 4 for marketed drugs only).

query.description: Search text for search_type=name — a drug name, ChEMBL ID, or InChIKey, e.g. "imatinib" or "CHEMBL25".

search_type.description: name = text lookup (query); exact = exact structure match; similarity = Tanimoto ≥ threshold; substructure = contains the structure. All structure modes need `structure`.

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum Tanimoto similarity percent for search_type=similarity (40–100; ChEMBL rejects below 40). Ignored for other modes.

structure.description: SMILES string for structure search, e.g. "CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O". Required when search_type is exact/similarity/substructure.

name: chembl_search_molecules

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: ChEMBL has no record for the requested identifier or structure. `rate_limited`: ChEMBL rate-limits the upstream request. `invalid_structure`: ChEMBL could not parse the SMILES of a similarity or substructure search. `missing_input`: Neither query nor structure was supplied, or a structure search_type was chosen without a structure. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: A compound matched by the search.

alogp.description: Calculated AlogP lipophilicity, e.g. 1.31. Null when absent.

canonical_smiles.description: Canonical SMILES structure. Null when no structure is recorded.

full_molformula.description: Molecular formula, e.g. "C9H8O4". Null when absent.

max_phase.description: Max clinical phase: 4 = approved, 3–1 = clinical trial phase, 0.5 = early phase 1, −1 = clinical with the phase unknown. Null when ChEMBL records no clinical development (a preclinical or research compound). The cheap druggability signal.

molecule_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL molecule ID, e.g. "CHEMBL25". Pass to chembl_get_bioactivities or chembl_get_drug_info.

molecule_type.description: Molecule type, e.g. "Small molecule". Null when absent.

mw_freebase.description: Molecular weight of the free base in g/mol, e.g. 180.16. Null when absent.

num_ro5_violations.description: Lipinski rule-of-five violation count (0–4). Null when not computed.

parent_chembl_id.description: The parent of the compound's family, e.g. "CHEMBL553" for erlotinib hydrochloride — the compound's own ID when it is the parent or ChEMBL records no hierarchy for it. A salt's measurements are a small share of its family's: pass the parent to chembl_get_drug_info, or set include_alternate_forms on chembl_get_bioactivities, to reach the whole family.

pref_name.description: Preferred name, e.g. "ASPIRIN". Null for many research compounds.

qed_weighted.description: QED weighted drug-likeness score, 0–1. Null when not computed.

similarity.description: Tanimoto similarity percent (0–100) to the query structure. Present only on search_type=similarity results; on every other search_type the key is absent, not null.

standard_inchi_key.description: Standard InChIKey — chain to the pubchem server for richer chemistry. Null when absent.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token for the next page — pass it back as cursor with the same filters. Absent when this page is the last one.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched — echoes the query and suggests how to broaden — the disclosure that a limit above the maximum was served at the maximum, and, when totalCountCapped is true, that the total is ChEMBL's search ceiling and how to narrow below it.

totalCount.description: Total compounds matching before the limit was applied — a lower bound when totalCountCapped is true.

totalCountCapped.description: True when totalCount is ChEMBL's ceiling for the search — 10000 for a name search, 30000 for a substructure search: at least that many compounds match, and no page past the ceiling can be reached. Narrow the query to bring the matches under it.

truncated.description: True when the result was capped at the limit.

title: chembl-search-molecules
